mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.nickname, u.avatar, (SELECT content FROM message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} AND receiver_id = u.id) OR (sender_id = u.id AND receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage, (SELECT create_time FROM message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} AND receiver_id = u.id) OR (sender_id = u.id AND receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE sender_id = u.id AND receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0) AS unreadCount FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT receiver_id AS uid FROM message WHERE sender_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT DISTINCT sender_id AS uid FROM message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} ) t JOIN user u ON t.uid = u.id ORDER BY lastTime DESC

SELECT m.id, m.sender_id AS senderId, m.receiver_id AS receiverId, m.content, m.is_read AS isRead, m.create_time AS createTime, u.nickname AS senderNickname, u.avatar AS senderAvatar FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.sender_id = u.id WHERE (m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.receiver_id = #{otherId}) OR (m.sender_id = #{otherId} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
